log: Openings emptied: 20021 triangles the generator left inside the redrawn windows and doors (torn glass, bent bars, shutters) were taken out.
Frames, sills and sash bars are real pieces standing off the wall, material trim, painted one color here.
Window bars: 1 window barred with straight iron bars on two rails, material bars.
Windows: 3 windows redrawn, each one whole pane the size of its opening (windows_lit) behind a frame and sash bars.

Rooms: 3 panes (6 lit, 0 dark), each made one clean rectangle where its glass was and painted with what hangs in it: 3 house windows. By day a pane is dark glass with the sky in it; windows_lit glows at night with the room behind (its emission map, at full strength for the game's clock to scale). 6 triangles of generated glass became 12.
